import hashlib
import pathlib
import sys

# Frozen pre-amendment base and the amended candidate. Both are read explicitly;
# nothing in this step relies on names defined elsewhere.
BASE_PATH = pathlib.Path(
    "proof/TP-DMX-SECOND-BRAIN-ADR-ACCEPTANCE-001-AC2-AMENDMENT/"
    "source-base-second-brain-adr-candidates.md"
)
CAND_PATH = pathlib.Path(
    "docs/03-reference/architecture/second-brain/adr-candidates/"
    "second-brain-adr-candidates.md"
)

BASE_SHA256 = "946054a4675271856e0214dbf1ce0aa9b1ec17e71e79a82711ad3ca0d9df9c22"
AMENDED_SHA256 = "e4b28946156096319557fd25e0289c5de4b593b6239cc5c7af9b3efed259b66c"
EXPECTED_REPLACEMENTS = 10

OLD = b"* Machine contracts and denial fixtures parse and cover the decision.\n"
NEW = (
    b"* Machine contracts required by this ADR MUST parse and cover the decision at ADR "
    b"acceptance. Required denial fixtures MUST be implemented, executed, and pass before "
    b"the affected implementation capability is authorized for enablement. Absence of "
    b"not-yet-implemented denial fixtures does not constitute implementation evidence and "
    b"does not permit any runtime, production, or enablement claim.\n"
)

base = BASE_PATH.read_bytes()
amended = CAND_PATH.read_bytes()

failures = []


def check(label, ok, detail=""):
    print(f"  [{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}] {label}" + (f" — {detail}" if detail else ""))
    if not ok:
        failures.append(label)


print("S3 — pure line replacement: byte-delta and round-trip (falsifiable)")

base_sha = hashlib.sha256(base).hexdigest()
amended_sha = hashlib.sha256(amended).hexdigest()
check("frozen base sha256 binding", base_sha == BASE_SHA256, base_sha)
check("amended candidate sha256 binding", amended_sha == AMENDED_SHA256, amended_sha)

n_old_base = base.count(OLD)
n_new_amended = amended.count(NEW)
check(f"pre-amendment AC#2 occurs exactly {EXPECTED_REPLACEMENTS}x in base",
      n_old_base == EXPECTED_REPLACEMENTS, f"found {n_old_base}")
check(f"amended AC#2 occurs exactly {EXPECTED_REPLACEMENTS}x in candidate",
      n_new_amended == EXPECTED_REPLACEMENTS, f"found {n_new_amended}")
check("amended AC#2 absent from base", base.count(NEW) == 0, f"found {base.count(NEW)}")
check("pre-amendment AC#2 absent from candidate",
      amended.count(OLD) == 0, f"found {amended.count(OLD)}")

predicted = EXPECTED_REPLACEMENTS * (len(NEW) - len(OLD))
observed = len(amended) - len(base)
check("byte delta matches prediction",
      observed == predicted, f"predicted {predicted}, observed {observed}")

forward = base.replace(OLD, NEW)
check("forward transformation base -> amended is exact",
      forward == amended,
      "byte-identical" if forward == amended
      else f"differs ({len(forward)}B vs {len(amended)}B)")

reverse = amended.replace(NEW, OLD)
check("reverse transformation amended -> base is exact",
      reverse == base,
      "byte-identical" if reverse == base
      else f"differs ({len(reverse)}B vs {len(base)}B)")

check("line count preserved (line replacement, not rewrite)",
      base.count(b"\n") == amended.count(b"\n"),
      f"{base.count(chr(10).encode())} -> {amended.count(chr(10).encode())}")

if failures:
    print(f"\nS3 FAILED: {len(failures)} check(s) failed: {failures}")
    sys.exit(1)
print("\nS3 PASSED: pure line replacement confirmed — "
      f"{EXPECTED_REPLACEMENTS} AC#2 lines, delta {observed}B, both round-trips exact.")
